name: BXP

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Bxp boston logo.png, PNG 722x474)

description: BXP is the largest-listed owner of premier office buildings in six gateway markets: Boston, Los Angeles, New York, San Francisco, Seattle and Washington, DC. At 2025-12-31 it owned or held joint-venture interests in 179 properties totaling about 52.6 million net rentable sq ft (157 office, 14 retail, 7 residential, 1 hotel; eight under development). Money is rent: long leases (weighted average remaining term about 7.9 years) to corporate and law-firm tenants, plus reimbursement of costs, with growth from re-leasing, new construction, and office-to-lab conversions. In-service occupancy was 86.7 percent at year-end 2025 and 88.4 percent at 2026-06-30.

businessLines.name: Office (including retail space within office properties)
businessLines.how: Tenants ('clients') pay monthly rent under multi-year leases, plus reimbursement of operating costs and taxes; income grows from contractual rent steps, re-leasing at market and new developments, and is hurt by vacancy and concessions.
businessLines.description: Class A office buildings in Boston, New York, San Francisco, Washington, Los Angeles and Seattle, including laboratory/life-science space; the 10-K segment table groups retail with office.
